articles.title: Small Caps Snapshot: Alkane uncovers copper-zinc mineralisation as Resolution extends gold discovery
articles.summary: Alkane Resources and Resolution Minerals are in focus in Wednesday’s small-cap news, with both companies reporting encouraging drilling results from their exploration projects. Alkane Resources has identified massive sulphide mineralisation at its Rockley project in New South Wales, where initial drilling at the Belmore East prospect intersected copper, zinc and silver mineralisation in holes spaced about 300 metres apart. The strongest intersection returned 45 metres at 0.55% copper and 1.15% zinc. Alkane plans further drilling and geophysical surveys over the next six months to determine the scale of the discovery. Meanwhile, Resolution Minerals has reported significant gold intersections at its Golden Gate North deposit in Idaho, strengthening geological continuity across the central mineralised zone. A standout result returned 272 metres at 0.55 grams per tonne gold from surface. Assays remain pending for another 30 drill holes, with the company targeting an initial mineral resource estimate in the first quarter of 2027.
